risks.reasoning: The accountants' report shows positive net cash from operating activities of USD 338,357 thousand for the six months ended 30 June 2021. Under Protocol v1.1.1, non-negative operating cash flow means there is no operating cash burn; monthly_operating_cash_burn and cash_runway_months must therefore be null, so the cash_runway risk is not applicable.

The audited historical statement reports positive net profit in each of the three comparable annual periods 2018, 2019 and 2020 (USD 572,620 thousand, USD 492,833 thousand and USD 314,597 thousand, respectively). The comparable interim periods for the six months ended 30 June 2020 and 2021 are also profitable. There are zero comparable loss periods, so the frozen continuous_loss threshold is not met.

Audited annual revenue decreased from USD 1,766,914 thousand in 2019 to USD 1,689,931 thousand in 2020, a comparable growth rate of -4.3569%. This is below 0% but above -20%, meeting the frozen medium threshold. The same audited statement also shows positive 2019 versus 2018 growth and a strong rebound in the comparable six-month 2021 period; these do not change the fact that the 2019-to-2020 comparable annual growth itself meets the medium trigger.

The Business section formally discloses that the five largest customers accounted for less than 30% of total net revenue in each year and period of the track record period. Because the largest customer is necessarily no greater than the top-five aggregate, both the largest-customer medium threshold (>=30%) and the top-five medium threshold (>=60%) are excluded; the high thresholds are also excluded.

risks.reasoning: The accountants' report discloses an actual contingent redemption obligation: after acquiring a majority stake in Jiamian Technology, the Group agreed in certain circumstances to redeem the minority interest held by its founder and CEO, and the interest is classified as redeemable non-controlling interest because the contingency is not wholly within the Group's control. This is an actual effective redemption right rather than boilerplate. Protocol v1.1.1 requires actual effective/restorable special rights to be marked needs_review; medium is retained only as the protocol's provisional candidate severity.

The Regulatory Overview discloses two SAMR antitrust investigation notices concerning alleged failure to make merger-control filings: one resulted in an RMB 500,000 fine and the other remained ongoing as of the prospectus date, with the Company unable to predict its status or outcome. This is an unresolved regulatory/compliance matter. Protocol v1.1.1 requires unresolved regulatory effects or ambiguity about materiality/resolution to be marked needs_review; medium is the provisional candidate severity.

The Business section states that Weibo began monetizing as early as 2012 and reports substantial revenue from advertising and marketing services, including USD 1,689.9 million in 2020 and USD 1,033.4 million in the six months ended 30 June 2021. The core social-media platform is therefore commercialized and revenue-generating, so the precommercial_product candidate condition is not met.
